approval.scope: Three-step legacy split freeze, full execution qualification, frozen evaluation and manuscript update explicitly approved after plan was quoted.

supersedes: Earlier preparation-only prohibition on legacy test inference; no change to frozen scientific models or selection.

comparison_scope.claim: numerical-history common-head TPP encoder comparison plus the two simple quantity references and two structural controls
comparison_scope.deep_renewal: excluded from manuscript comparison at user request after its validation results existed; preserve all runs and research records; this scope is not evidence of dominance over native distributional demand predictors
comparison_scope.selection_transparency: Do not invent a pre-result exclusion rationale or describe native methods as invalid because they outperform TitanTPP. Method-family scope limits the claim and does not erase retrospective comparator-selection concerns.
comparison_scope.A100: cross-product and recent-four-mean remain separately reported single-seed exploration; neither replaces the representative

resampling.taxi_grid: all hours between first and last eligible evaluation target time, including empty hours without imputed targets
resampling.implementation_and_real_data_CIs_status: 31 tests and 108-condition validation sample pipeline verified (84 reused, 24 new); no benchmark-wide or held-out CIs
resampling.primary_unit: Whole declared entity/site clusters; Intermittent whole sites preserve within-site series dependence; Taxi shared calendar blocks preserve cross-cell temporal shocks.
resampling.paired_entity_cluster_sensitivity_for_ta: 10,000 complete-cell cluster draws, reported as a sensitivity conditional on cells; cannot substitute for shared-time primary uncertainty
resampling.upper_level_dependency_gate: If site or system clustering violates the declared unit, freeze a metadata-justified higher-level plan before outcome release or limit inference; never select a favorable unit from CIs.

release.before_test: Local unit tests, full data-loader enumeration, CUDA validation qualification and source/contract seals must pass.
release.reporting: All 108 conditions and two deterministic references per dataset, including failures. No model selection using these results.
release.failure_policy: Preserve attempt and diagnose; no automatic scientific changes or favorable target intersections.
